overview:
Silverlight Research is a London-based institutional expert network founded in November 2017 by a former Morgan Stanley investment manager. The company operates with a distinctive fully distributed workforce model — all staff work part-time and remotely across key regions including EMEA (Portugal, Turkey, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia), the Americas (New York, Colombia), and Asia (Singapore, Pakistan, Hong Kong, Philippines).

Despite its lean structure, Silverlight serves some of the world's largest private equity funds, hedge funds, long-only funds, sovereign wealth funds, and Fortune 500 corporations. The company maintains a 97% engagement success rate and a 61% expert acceptance rate. Perhaps most notably, 65% of new clients come from existing referrals — suggesting strong satisfaction among institutional buyers.

Silverlight manages end-to-end expert sourcing, screening, compliance, scheduling, and documentation for time-bound practitioner consultations aligned with institutional research workflows. In April 2025, the company briefly launched 'Greystone expert network' as a separate branch under the same corporate entity.

history.narrative:
Silverlight Research was founded in November 2017 by a former Morgan Stanley investment manager who recognized an opportunity to build an expert network with an institutional investor's perspective. The founder's investment management background shaped Silverlight's approach — the company speaks the language of its institutional clients and understands the compliance, speed, and quality requirements of buy-side research.

The company adopted a fully distributed workforce model from inception, avoiding the overhead of traditional office-based operations. This allows Silverlight to maintain competitive pricing while deploying research and operations staff across global time zones.
